correctness.rationale: Exact Bernoulli-conditioned A0,A1 matrices yield the six-dimensional symmetric moment map. The symbolic determinant is γq²[(q−1)γ²+(7q−8)γ+6q−4]. For q>2/3 the explicit P≻0 solves a strict internal Lyapunov equation at γ=0; the simple slow eigenvalue derivative is −2. The positive-cone Perron crossing argument establishes the full sharp stable interval. The A0 Jordan structure and A1 action show irreducibility, forcing the dual Perron matrix positive definite and making the primal error obstruction valid for every nonzero initial state when 0<q<1. Exact rational enumerations and symbolic verification passed. q=1 is handled separately.

value.rationale: The sharp q>2/3 threshold prevents stabilization by any positive step when maximal feedback is combined with sufficiently frequent erasures, including correct-gradient initialization. Its analytical γ*(q) curve offers a precise stability guide and a boundary for feedback-regulation design, not a trivial normalization check or a generic numerical threshold.
